title: Refused split, then a genuine later acceptance

dates.source: Proposed 2027 window only. Not a confirmed stock or Pricing date.

stock_fixture.first_window: only split beds, in different rooms

turns.guest: Two of us, Rae and Jo. We must stay together, 14 to 18 August 2027.
turns.tool_result: only beds in different rooms are free
must: say they cannot stay together in one room on these dates
leave no booking, hold, or payment link
must_not: reuse the refused split as an accepted offer

turns.guest: If a later week in 2027 has one room for both of us, we will take that instead.

later_window.requires: a fresh tool result with one same-room pair, not the refused split

must: treat this sentence as interest, not consent
do not book, hold, or create a payment link from this sentence
a fresh tool result is required before any quote can be accepted
must_not: reuse the old offer or hold
turns.name: later_interest
accept_fresh_quote
turns.guest: Yes, we accept the fresh quote for 21 to 25 August 2027, both of us in that same room. Book that quote only.

fresh_quote.source: a fresh tool result with one same-room pair, not the refused split

must: book only after this explicit acceptance of the fresh quote
quote it again with Staff before this acceptance is stored as consent
create only the newly agreed booking
must_not: reuse the old offer or hold
treat the earlier interest sentence as consent

pass: refusal writes nothing; only a later explicit acceptance of a fresh quote creates the new agreed booking
